description:
Gong Bath-Sound Meditation, Join Nick for this weekly Gong Bath-Sound Meditations on Wednesdays at 5.30 pm to unwind from the stress of the day and reset your nervous system. Having played gongs around Wellington for two or so years in various yoga studios, this event is a pivot towards offering the local community a regular space to enjoy the sounds in a modern and central spot.

If you haven't been to an event like this before, some of the benefits come from the sounds assisting the brain to reach deeper, more restful brainwave states, while the steady drones invite the nervous system to relax into the rest & digest mode. The sounds themselves are unlike anything else really, and sound like some kind of rich, harmonic, electronic music.

Nick has been producing and playing with music since his earliest teens, having graduated from The New Zealand School of Music, and later with a University qualification and work experience in experiential Psychology.
This event will feature a short grounding practise to help you settle into your seat.

If you live with any of these, please talk to your Doctor first, to make sure the event will be suitable:
-have a pacemaker or other implanted medical device
-live with epilepsy or a sound-sensitive condition
-are in the first trimester of pregnancy
-are experiencing severe or unmanaged mental health challenges (such as psychosis, schizophrenia, or PTSD)

Please bring along anything that'll help you feel more comfortable (yoga mat, pillow, eye mask, blanket, or earplugs if you live with tinnitus).
label: Religion & Spirituality

description:
Harmonic Resonance, Join Bianca and Nicola for an immersive Reiki Meditation and Harmonic Resonance Sound Journey at a peaceful underground location central to Wellington City. Experience the sacred stillness of this inner-city sanctuary.
What to expect
Beginning with a warm welcome and a complimentary serving of blue lotus tea to assist you in deep relaxation.
Nicola of Soul Alignment Sanctuary will guide and ground you through a soothing and radiant meditation. Integrating reiki, light language, and planetary astrology, Nicola brings in the deep presence of the tree realms, anchoring grounding energy through our internal connections to nature.
You will then be led gently into a sonic sound bath of Astral Inquisitions with Bianca - lasting approximately 50 minutes.
Known historically for their deeply transformative benefits, enhancing brainwave coherence and healing, gongs will be at the heart of this journey with their full spectrum of harmonics and complex overtones encompassing a very aural experience.
These harmonic soundscapes become vast therapeutic landscapes as resonant frequencies harmonize and vibrate. Featuring a wide array of complementing instruments such as crystal singing bowls, Tibetan bowls, chimes, resonating pyramids, medicine/ocean/shamanic drums - combining to create an immersive and meditative vibrational experience.
These waves can reach deep into your body and heal on a cellular level, so each individual journey is unique.
The sound meets you where you are, allowing for personal revitalization, enhancing wellbeing and creating a platform for personal growth.
You may experience physical, emotional, and mental relaxation, visions, self-healing, spiritual transformation, and tension release.
We will close with quiet re-integration, with space for journalling and a gentle return to the present.
I invite you to join us for an afternoon of sacred pause, inner clarity, and leave feeling more spacious, balanced and restored.
Comfort / What to bring
Please your own mat, blanket, pillow or eye mask if you wish for personal comfort.
Water bottle
Journal and pen
Personal totems to support your journey
Contraindications
Not suitable for those with sound-induced epilepsy or during the first trimester of pregnancy.
If unsure, please consult with your healthcare provider.
Please arrive 10 mins early to settle in as the journey will start at 2pm
Allow time for parking - located center Wellington City
label: Religion & Spirituality

description:
Harmonic Sound Journey at Space with Claudio SOLD OUT!, Harmonic Sound Journey at Space with Claudio SOLD OUT!
We invite you to a special evening of Sacred Harmonic Sound with multi-instrumentalist Claudio Escutia. This immersive sound journey offers a deeply restorative experience that invites you to settle into stillness, reconnect with the heart, and explore a sense of inner spaciousness through vibration and tone.
Claudio skilfully layers the sounds of gongs, crystal and Tibetan singing bowls, Native American flutes, and other traditional instruments, enhanced through high-quality audio equipment so the sound can be both heard and felt throughout your body.
Harmonic sound and vibration offer the nervous system a chance to truly rest. In this state of relaxation, the thinking mind softens, and we find connection to citta — the heart-mind. From this place, silence arises naturally through the vehicle of sound.
This experience is open to everyone. No previous yoga or meditation practice is needed.

What to bring:
You are welcome to bring your own yoga mat, though studio mats are also available. We will provide bolsters, blankets, and eye pillows for your comfort.

Booking is essential — spaces are limited and this event often fills quickly.

About Claudio
Claudio is a multi-instrumentalist musician originally from Mexico City and now based in Wellington. Born into a family of musicians, he began playing music at a young age and later studied classical guitar. His journey led him to Montreal, where he explored jazz, world music, and spiritual sound traditions.

Extensive travels in Asia and Europe deepened his connection with Indian music and yogic philosophy. He studied Tibetan singing bowls in Kathmandu and Varanasi, and has since worked with a wide range of instruments including the sitar, esraj, bansuri, harmonium, flutes, gongs, and voice.

Claudio’s work blends technical skill, deep presence, and a profound respect for the healing power of sound.

Learn more or listen to Claudio’s music here:
SoundCloud https://soundcloud.com/claudioescutiasounds
Instagram https://www.instagram.com/claudio_yoga_sound_healing
Facebook https://www.facebook.com/soundhealingyogamusicclaudio

Claudio skilfully layers the sounds of gongs, crystal and Tibetan singing bowls, Native American flutes, and other traditional instruments, enhanced through high-quality audio equipment so the sound can be both heard and felt throughout your body.
Harmonic sound and vibration offer the nervous system a chance to truly rest. In this state of relaxation, the thinking mind softens, and we find connection to citta — the heart-mind. From this place, silence arises naturally through the vehicle of sound.
This experience is open to everyone. No previous yoga or meditation practice is needed.
What to bring:
You are welcome to bring your own yoga mat, though studio mats are also available. We will provide bolsters, blankets, and eye pillows for your comfort.
Booking is essential — spaces are limited and this event often fills quickly.
About Claudio
Claudio is a multi-instrumentalist musician originally from Mexico City and now based in Wellington. Born into a family of musicians, he began playing music at a young age and later studied classical guitar. His journey led him to Montreal, where he explored jazz, world music, and spiritual sound traditions.
Extensive travels in Asia and Europe deepened his connection with Indian music and yogic philosophy. He studied Tibetan singing bowls in Kathmandu and Varanasi, and has since worked with a wide range of instruments including the sitar, esraj, bansuri, harmonium, flutes, gongs, and voice.
Claudio’s work blends technical skill, deep presence, and a profound respect for the healing power of sound.

Immerse yourself in a transformative yoga experience that blends movement, sound, and color to awaken and balance your chakra

About this Event

Immersive Yoga: a Journey Through Chakra Energy

It’s more than yoga — it’s an experience.
Immerse yourself in the radiant world of chakras with this transformative yoga event designed to awaken and balance your inner energy. Blending traditional yoga with modern immersive visuals and sound, this session takes you on a sensory journey from the root to the crown.
Aromatherapy and soundscapes will harmonize with each chakra as you move through your practice, supporting a deep sense of alignment and flow.
Throughout the session, the space will come alive with dynamic color projections — grounding reds, creative oranges, golden yellows, soft greens, tranquil blues, intuitive indigos, and luminous violets. Created in collaboration with a visual artist, these shifting hues mirror the energy of each chakra, deepening your awareness and connection to self.
Feel your energy awaken as movement, breath, and color merge into a meditative rhythm — a deeply relaxing and revitalizing experience for body and mind.



Plus, your evening includes a nourishing plant-based dinner and dessert, a delicious way to conclude your journey.



Meet Nicola, your teacher
The essence of Namaste Nicola’s teaching is soulful, gently guiding you through the yoga experience to a deeper connection with yourself.
She has over 20 years of teaching in Australia and New Zealand, and over 300 hours of training with International lead trainers, and forever expanding her knowledge. The yoga philosophy, the poses, the movement now interweaves through her entire being, thinking, relationships with others and herself. Yoga isn’t something she does, it is who she is, and it is a joy to guide others in their hatha or yin practice.

description:
Inner Child Workshop - Shamanic Way, Inner Child Healing – Shamanic Way
Inner child healing has been explored in many therapeutic and healing modalities. Each approach offers its own wisdom and light, helping people in unique ways. What truly transformed my journey, however, is the foundational practice within my shamanic training — Inner Child Healing. It’s not an intellectual or analytical process, but a deeply intuitive and feeling-based journey that helps us dive into the psyche and reconnect with younger versions of ourselves that may have become lost or stuck in time.

In shamanic practice, we understand the inner child as a deeply activated part of the nervous system. In other words, healing your inner child means bringing safety to your nervous system, allowing the wounded part of you — the one constantly on alert — to finally rest. Your inner child is your nervous system. When that child feels safe, seen, and loved within your body, they can simply be the child they were never allowed to be. At that point, you no longer need to constantly “regulate” your nervous system through endless spiritual practices — because much of what gets triggered in daily life often comes from an unmet or unhappy inner child.

Once you learn to create a safe internal space for your inner child to simply be, and allow your embodied, grounded adult self to take responsibility in life, you’ll witness profound shifts in how you feel, respond, and relate to the world.

In this workshop, I will share the foundational understanding of how inner child healing unfolds in everyday life. Through a guided shamanic journey, you’ll be led to meet or reconnect with your inner child and begin integrating a healthy adult archetype within your system.

If you feel called to explore your inner child, work on a deeper, more embodied level — one that you can carry into your daily life —
join me this Labour Weekend at Capricorn Spirit Crystal Shop, from 3pm to 6pm.
Spaces are limited to 6 participants, and I look forward to journeying with you there.

Yoga without mantra is a bit like cake without the icing!

By now, we all know that everything essentially is vibration.
Yoga knew this 1000's of years ago, that is why sound is the first tool of Yoga.
The use of a mantra is a powerful tool for healing, emotional and mental clarity, and spiritual development.
Learn about the pranavah mantra ( om) as it relates to Yoga Practice.
In this 2-hour workshop, you will be taught the traditional and respectful way to use this sacred sound and what it means.

We will draw on the ancient texts of Yoga as our point of reference (Patanjali's Yoga Sutras).

You will be guided in a variety of accessible practices to experience the effects of this mantra.
This workshop can open new dimensions to your practice, or it is also a great way to start on the Yoga Journey.

I teach from the Viniyoga tradition of Krishnamacharya, where mantra is used as an integral aspect of Yoga, whether it be asana, pranayama, or meditation.
This workshop will be nourishing to all the dimensions -heart, mind, and body.
You do not need to be a singer at all-just be willing to have a go at making a sound, even in your head if out loud feels too weird.Tickets $40 from Humanatrix https://events.humanitix.com/journey-into-om/tickets

description:
Journey to Bethlehem - St Peter's part of the 2025 Christmas Crawl, The days after school finishes can be hectic with Christmas preparations, shopping and busy family life - sometimes the original story of Christmas gets lost in all that. In the days leading up to Christmas, bring your whānau to enjoy time to slow down and be present to the story, in activities and experiences at six of our city churches.
Each church will be creating displays, installations, activities and self-guided tours, all designed to give everyone – adults and especially children – a meaningful understanding of the Christmas story. All of the churches will be open from 11am-3pm each day for visitors.
The ‘Christmas Crawl’ will run on Monday 22nd through Wednesday 24th December.
Details of each church’s particular Christmas display and activity can be found on the Christmas Crawl website www.christmascrawl.org.nz and the location map is also available for downloading.

KC Productions presents
Kelvin Cruickshank Live!
“The With Love From Spirit” Tour

Coming to Porirua for one time only for 2026!

After pay available! Tickets for sale on iticket.

Internationally known New Zealand Medium, Kelvin Cruickshank, brings a powerful
evening of connection, comfort and spiritual insight to audiences across New Zealand.

During this live event, Kelvin demonstrates his ability to communicate with loved ones
in spirit, delivering heart felt messages filled with love, validation and healing.

Through humour, compassion and accuracy, Kelvin shows that the bond between this
world and the next is never broken. Kelvin will often use his own life experiences and
insights to allow audience members to connect and interpret signs to deepen their own
connections and understanding of the spirit world.

As the evening unfolds you will be swept away on a journey of connection, compassion
and love. Many people find that these experiences leave them with a renewed sense of
hope, purpose, clarity and the understanding that love continues beyond our physical
realm.

Kelvin and his team look forward to welcoming you to one of his upcoming shows in
your area in 2026. Join us for an evening filled with love, healing and learning from our spirit family.

“When we think of them, They stand with us.”

description:
Kohael Sound Journey Paraparaumu, Come and be held in a ceremony of sound.
Sunday 14th, from 2:22 PM to 4:04 PM at Lotus Yoga, Papamaru, an immersive Sound Journey awaits you.
This is a time and space to breathe, release, and be nurtured by the deep vibrations of medicinal instruments including Didgeridoo, HandPan, Jaw Harps, Shamanic Drone Flute, Shamanic Drum, Mongolian Throat Singing (Sygyt and Khoomei), and more — all amplified and layered through a loop station.
Comfortably lying down, you’ll be guided on a relaxing, clearing, and rejuvenating inner journey. This transformative experience supports your nervous system, helping to release tension and restore calm and presence.
Benefits of Sound Healing
Mental clarity and emotional balance
Deep relaxation and revitalization
Enhanced focus and memory
Better sleep quality
Strengthened immune response
Boosted creativity
Heightened self-awareness and environmental sensitivity
What to Bring
Comfortable clothing
A mattress, pillow, blanket, eye mask — anything to support your full comfort
Water bottle
An open heart
Event Guidelines
To create a held and focused space:
Please silence your phone before entering
Arrive on time — we recommend 2:12 for a smooth, grounded start. Doors close at 2:22 PM sharp.
This offering is part of the Kohael Project, where I (Justin) and fellow co-creators offer well-being practices in exchange for koha or donation — supporting personal transformation and collective healing.

https://www.instagram.com/kohaelproject/

With gratitude and love,
Justin

description:
LAMMAS FULL MOON SONG AND SOUND CEREMONY, LAMMAS FULL MOON SONG AND SOUND CEREMONY
Come and Sing, Sound and Meditate!

Want to mark the important time of the JANUARY/ fEBRUARY LAMMAS full moon? Lammas is the Celtic festival of the first Harvest.

Come and join with us on Sunday the 1st February for a group ceremonial gathering in Paraparaumu.

We will explore sacred conscious sounding practices to balance and align the energy system, sing healing chants and songs from different traditions, and explore guided vocal improvisation for freedom, upliftment and joy!

Ceremonial cacao will be served with focus and healing intention.

There will be guided journal prompts around the energy of the Solstice and the whole session will finish with a full sound healing.

Everyone is welcome and there is no need for any particular preparation or pre existing skill.

Please get in touch with any questions or to book. Come and enjoy Song, Chant, Sound and Healing!!

So looking forward to gathering for the Lammas Full Moon. Come and join with us to invoke and celebrate the energies of balance, creation, abundance and celebration at this profound time of year.

This session will explore singing, chanting, sounding and conscious voice empowerment practices. We will also explore energy practices like Qigong and meditation. All within a ceremonial framework.

Everyone is welcome. Limited spaces. Get in touch soon

You are warmly invited to book to join this powerful sound and voice ceremony which will work with Spirit, the forces of Nature and Bryony's skill and expertise in creating sound for growth and transformation.

This is a special opportunity to tune into the sacred energies and potentialities of this time: opening us up to balance, healing, nourishment, new growth and positive change.

Bryony will invoke and work with the healing power of the supportive energies of Spirit, ancestors and our highest Selves. Bryony's has an extensive background experience with Spirit, the Earth forces and sacred lands; these forces are central to her practice and Self.

She will lead you firstly in a process of meditation, conscious sounding, toning and singing healing chants.

This use of our voices to co-create a sacred group sound is uplifting and transformative and will support you in your process of healing, releasing and visioning.

There will be time for guided journaling and intention setting.

The second section of the workshop will be a focused and dedicated sound bath which will bring balance and deep relaxation, into a sense of stillness and peace. There can be a sense of gratitude and appreciation.

Both the conscious use of the voice and the sound healing have many benefits, which are verified by science and which can effect us positively on the physical, mental, emotional, energetic and spiritual levels. A document which has more information about these benefits can be provided on request.

All are welcome:
I look forward to sharing with you and supporting you in this ceremony.

description:
LIQUID PRAYER - Somatic Dance, LIQUID PRAYER
(more than) a somatic dance journey...
Join embodiment facilitators Jenna Joan & Sonic Sutra for an evening of ritual, connection, ceremonial cacao, freeform movement, and live soundscape.
🌑 Friday 16 January
🕕 7–9.30pm
📍 Thistle Hall, Wellington
🎟️ $35–$55
✨ Sober · Non-judgemental · All welcome · No experience needed
No door sales - tickets must be purchased online prior to the event.
As we land in the new year, we gather in reverence of what it means to be human...each of us; the entire ocean in a drop. When we connect to the rivers that flow within, we are reminded of our divinity: we are nature and we can find liberation in our sense of belonging as a part of the whole.
This is a space to FLOW FREELY, FEEL FULLY and anchor in any new year intentions as we transition from the year of the snake to the year of the fire horse.
We’ll begin our ritual with ceremonial cacao and a grounding meditation, then drop into a guided movement journey with live soundscape. There are no steps to learn, no performance—just presence, curiosity, and letting your body move as it feels. Barefoot and phone-free, you’re invited to drop deep into free-form movement, awakening the divine currents that flow through you.
Come as you are.
Move with what you feel.
Leave feeling empowered, connected, and alive.
Somatic dance is a guided movement practice that helps you tune into your body’s wisdom and move from the inside out. Unlike ecstatic dance, which is typically an open, DJ-led space with no facilitation, somatic dance offers gentle guidance to support you in exploring sensation, emotion, and embodiment in a safe, intentional way. You’re not learning steps or performing—you're being invited into presence, curiosity, and feeling. With a focus on nervous system regulation, personal expression, and inner listening, somatic dance creates a nurturing space to come home to yourself.
Your Hosts...
Jenna Joan | Embodiment Facilitator
Jenna Joan is a somatic family constellation therapist, yoga teacher, and group facilitator who has been leading movement spaces for over 15 years. With a background in yoga, somatic dance, and therapeutic embodiment, her work blends play, authenticity, ancestral healing, and deep nervous system awareness. Jenna is also a cacao alchemist and ceremonial facilitator, known for creating safe, soulful spaces that invite freedom, connection, and inner exploration. She has been hosting workshops, retreats, and community events for nearly a decade, and also works 1:1 in more therapeutic settings.
Sonic Sutra | Somatic Dance DJ
Sonic Sutra is a sound artist and somatic dance DJ who creates immersive musical journeys designed to support authentic movement, emotional release, and deep embodiment. With a focus on somatic dance and therapeutic soundscapes, their sets are intentionally curated to guide dancers through an inner experience—honouring the body’s natural rhythms and the intelligence within. Their offerings create safe, accessible spaces for people of all bodies, backgrounds, and experience levels to explore movement, presence, and connection. Rooted in play, precision, and deep listening, Sonic Sutra brings music that moves beyond entertainment—into healing and transformation.

description:
Letting Go: A ritual for fresh starts, Letting Go: A ritual for fresh starts
If you’ve been through a redundancy, restructure, or a big shift in your working life - or if you’ve been out of work for a while and are looking ahead to something new - this gathering is for you.
We’ll spend an hour outdoors (weather permitting) in a gentle, guided ritual to help you release some of the heaviness that comes with change and open up to what’s next. You can expect moments of quiet reflection, light movement, and simple nature-based activities designed to connect you with yourself, the land, and a sense of possibility. There’s no chanting, costumes, or anything too out-there - just a safe, thoughtful space to mark what you’ve been through and welcome in the next chapter.
The ritual will be hosted by Tamara Buckland - Leadership Strategist, Chief People Officer, and Druid - who blends leadership wisdom with nature-based practices to create meaningful, accessible experiences for people in transition.
After the ritual, we’ll wander to Picnic Café for coffee or tea (you’ll just need to cover your own drink) for those who’d like to keep connecting.
Details
📅 Friday 29 August (rain date: Friday 5 September)
🕛 12:00–1:00pm ritual
☕ 1:00pm coffee/tea at Picnic Café
💸 Free (pay for your own drink at the café)
📍 Wellington - location shared on registration
This is for anyone ready to put down some of the weight they’ve been carrying, connect with nature and themselves, and make space for the next chapter.

Little Revolutions 2026 - Wellington, Little Revolutions 2026: Renewed Neighbourhoods
We follow the One who “became flesh and moved into the neighbourhood.” The way of Jesus calls us over the fence, across the road, and to the ends of the earth. True revival never ends in a Sunday gathering—it spills into transformed neighbourhoods where there is “good news for the poor, release for the captive, recovery of sight for the blind, and liberty for those who are oppressed.”
This year we’re delighted to welcome Dave Mann from Bonny Downs, London. Together with his wife Sally, Dave serves as a Baptist pastor planting new faith communities in lower socio-economic and Muslim-majority neighbourhoods. They also established the Bonny Downs Community Association, a vital vehicle for neighbourhood renewal. Their story is beautifully told in Sally’s book, Looking for Lydia.

description:
Meditation - Journeys Every Tuesday Evening, Meditation - Journeys Every Tuesday Evening
Every Tuesday night we welcome you into the magic of the bell tent. The tent is lovely during the day, but as it gets dark, it takes on a magical feeling. Fairy lights and crystals lit by gently changing coloured lights. We have the fire going if it's cold, the sky curtain pulled if it's a clear night.

The evening starts with us welcoming in the Elements, the Directions and the web of life, into our sacred circle. Arniya then dances the energy in with Celestial Energy Movement, for the group. This creates a vortex of Divine power into the middle of the tent. Each person is linked into this Divine power, and receives a "top-up" of Divinity.
We then have an opportunity for each person to hold the Talking Stick and send positive energy to their life, or current experience, or to ask the Divine for help. This is completely optional. Throughout the evening, you will have opportunities to choose oracle cards to support your guidance through life.

At 8pm the Zoom people join our circle. They will get to choose an oracle card and be connected into the vortex of power in the tent. This always creates an energy of expansion within the group.
Arniya then gives a wee run down of any current energies influencing the planet, before she leads everyone on a Journey Meditation. Some weeks we to the V.U soul plane. Sometimes we travel to our inner world. Sometimes the guardians take us somewhere else entirely. Each journey is channelled to support the needs of whoever is present.
After the meditation, we say goodbye to our Zoom friends, close the energy on the circle and give thanks. After this journey is complete, we have a cup of tea - time for a chat or playing with oracle cards, enjoying each other’s company in the uplifted space.

This is normally a fairly jovial group. Sacredness is embraced fully, but not at the expense of a good giggle when it’s called for.

description:
Mexican Prehispanic Experience at AWHI, Join Claudio in his Mexican project called Xochipilli´s Eye. Xochipilli (Pronounce: Zo-chee-pee-lee) is the Mexica god of music, flowers, arts, and sacred plants.
Claudio´s last trip home to Mexico was full of inspiration, reconnecting him to his ancestral roots in Mexico City. He was fortunate to meet a prehispanic musician and instrument maker who plays and crafts beautiful traditional instruments. Claudio returned to NZ with many special new instruments; and continues to be inspired and guided by the cultural wealth, wisdom, and knowledge of the ancient cultures of the Americas.
This event will be extraordinary and unique. You will learn about Mexican prehispanic cosmology and spirituality. Experience simple and powerful rituals together with unique musical instruments used by Olmecs, Toltecs, Aztecs, and Mayans. The instruments include clay flutes, clay drums, medicine drums, ocarinas, wooden flutes, shells, and shakers skilfully arranged to create magical shamanic atmospheres.
We will be sharing Cacao which is an energetic traditional Mexican prehispanic drinks that help open the heart, reconnect with the earth element, ignite your fire, and get you up and moving.
What to expect:
Cleansing copal and herbal welcoming.
Talk about the use of music in the ancient times.
An opening ceremony to acknowledge the Tlalmanalli (offering and altar) with the deep sound of the conch shell in the four directions.
Cacao ceremony: Claudio will offer the cacao drink as a connection with the earth, to yourself, and the moment.
Live music that invokes many emotions and imagery, from contemplative natural and mystical environments to uplifting and empowering rhythms. You are free to project and explore within and/ or express and liberate projecting outwards.
We will finish with a shamanic atmosphere relaxation and close the event with a traditional chant.
No previous experience is required.
What to bring:
Wear comfortable clothing! Bring an open heart and a mind ready to learn and receive. You are also welcome to bring a fruit and or a flower to contribute to the altar.
Date & Time: Saturday, April 13th, 6-7:30pm
Location: AWHI Yoga & Wellbeing, Level 2, 15 Johnston Street, Wellington Central
Investment: $55

description:
Psychic Medium Kerry-Marie 'Bridging The 2 Worlds' - Wellington, Kerry-Marie Callander, the internationally trained and renowned psychic medium from TVNZ’s Sensing Murder, has announced her 2026 New Zealand tour “Bridging The 2 Worlds”. The nationwide tour will visit Whangarei, Auckland, Hamilton, Tauranga, Palmerston North, Wellington, and Christchurch in February and March 2026.

With more than 25 years of experience, Kerry-Marie will deliver powerful live demonstrations of mediumship, offering audiences the opportunity to connect with loved ones in spirit.

Kerry-Marie appeared on the highly rated television series Sensing Murder in 2018, providing insight into unsolved murder cases across New Zealand and Australia. She has built a strong reputation for delivering credible and heartfelt evidence of the spirit world both on and off the screen. A familiar media personality, she has been featured in Woman’s Day, the NZ Herald, Stuff and interviewed on radio stations including More FM, ZM, and George FM.

Widely recognised as one of New Zealand’s most qualified psychic mediums, Kerry-Marie trained at the prestigious Arthur Findlay College in the United Kingdom and is an accredited member of the Spiritualists’ National Union (SNU), one of the world’s largest spiritualist organisations. She now shares her expertise by training students across New Zealand and online, in addition to her work as a wedding celebrant and Reiki Master.

Her 2017 autobiography Breaking Free chronicles her personal transformation and path to mediumship, while her podcast Spiritual Truths features international guests exploring mind, body, and soul topics.

“Sensing Murder gave me the opportunity to connect with families searching for answers about their missing loved ones,” says Kerry-Marie. “On this tour, I want to continue helping people feel close to those they’ve lost. I’m also proud to be donating a portion of profits to Hospice, a service I care deeply about.”

Kerry-Marie’s live show is healing, uplifting and insightful. Be prepared for some wonderful surprises and uplifting messages. This is something you don’t want to miss out on!

description:
Qi Gong, Qi Gong
Qigong has both psychological and physical components and involves the regulation of the mind, breath, and body’s movement and posture.
In most forms of qigong:
Breath is slow, long, and deep. Breath patterns may switch from abdominal breathing to breathing combined with speech sounds.
Movements are typically gentle and smooth, aimed for relaxation.
Mind regulation includes focusing one’s attention and visualization.
Dynamic (active) qigong techniques primarily focus on body movements, especially movements of the whole body or arms and legs. Meditative (passive) qigong techniques can be practiced in any posture that can be maintained over time and involve breath and mind exercises, with almost no body movement.
Wear loose, comfortable clothing and bring a bottle of water.
[This is a physical activity that involves an element of risk.  While all possible measures are taken to prevent accidents or injury, please note that participation is at your own risk].

description:
Rangatiratanga for Life - Becoming the CEO of Yourself, The day is designed to stretch and grow you! In the whakatauākī of Tā Apirana Ngata (Ngāti Porou), E tipu, e rea, he exhorts us to 'grow and flourish'. Grow and flourish! More than survive, get by, do ok. Flourish! This day will explore ways to fully engage with the beautiful moemoeā this whakatauākī speaks to.
E Tipu, E Rea
E tipu e rea mō ngā rā o tō ao
Ko tō ringa ki ngā rākau a te Pākehā
Hei ora mō te tinana
Ko tō ngākau ki ngā taonga a ō tīpuna Māori
Hei tikitiki mō tō māhunga
Ko tō wairua ki tō atua, nāna nei ngā mea katoa
Grow and branch forth for the days destined to you
Your hands to the tools of the Pākehā for the welfare of your body
Your heart to the treasures of your ancestors as adornments for your brow
Your spirit to God, who made all things
— Sir Apirana Ngata

You may like to think about how the day can help you align your professional work-based objectives (often expressed as KPI’s) with your personal vision, mission and goals.
The aims of the Course are to:
1. To host a mana ake wānanga exploring your unique future;
2. To bring together a group of people interested in creating rangatiratanga in their lives;
3. To draw from mātauranga Māori to support participants to create a 12-month personal strategic plan (drawing on moemoeā, pūrakau and pūtake);
4. To facilitate learning using Māori learning and teaching styles;
5. To connect people to the power of lifelong learning; and,
6. To add to the network of dedicated, Treaty based nation builders who have the goal of 'Becoming a CEO' on their radar for themselves or someone they know, whether that be at the personal, whānau, hapῡ, iwi or organisational level.
Our programme is interactive and delivered through a range of teaching / learning techniques which also include: facilitation; small group discussion; critical analysis; reflection; and, reporting back.

Buddha Vajrapani empowerment and teachings
with Kadam Birgit

Buddha Vajrapani is the Buddha of spiritual power, sometimes referred to as the Buddha of skillful means.
With the development of spiritual power, we possess the confidence, inner strength and skill not only to take on and defeat our own delusions, but to be of great benefit in helping free others from their delusions as well.
Nothing could be more meaningful.

The empowerment is a beautiful and inspiring guided meditation and ritual in which we are introduced to Buddha Vajrapani from whom we then receive many blessings, adding great power to our own practice as well as sowing seeds for our future attainment of enlightenment.

In the afternoon Kadam Birgit will give a commentary on the beautiful Tantric practice and sadhana of Buddha Vajrapani.

Discover the unique aromas and healing properties of over thirty pure, therapeutic-grade essential oils. Use your aromatic concentrate to craft a collection of beautiful aromatic products — for yourself or to gift to those you love.
A series of three workshops — book one, or book them all.

Make up to nine bespoke products worth over $200, and discover the joy and skill of being an artisan maker.

description:
SIKA Sound Journey - KAPITI, SIKA Sound Journey - KAPITI
SIKA Sound Journey - 'Between the Worlds'
Something between an ancient ceremony and a movie soundtrack.

Please bring a yoga mat, pillow and blanket. Be prepared to drop into a deep space.
Door sales will be available if there is space. Advanced booking is recommended.

Between the Worlds is an evening Sound Journey shaped by over thirty years of deep ceremonial and immersive sound practice. Blending primal rhythm, atmospheric voice, deep didgeridoo, and field recordings, the journey unfolds organically — shifting from dynamic, embodied energy into vast, cinematic stillness.

This is not passive listening.
It is an experience to be entered.

As sound layers, dissolve, and reform, participants are guided into a liminal space where time softens and inner landscapes awaken. The journey becomes a passage — one that listeners don’t just hear, but inhabit.

Guided by the myth of the Wandering Forest Spirit, Between the Worlds invites a reconnection with self, with nature, and with something older than language. Ceremonial, immersive, and deeply evocative, this is an evening to slow down, listen deeply, and cross into the unseen.
It's like a soundtrack that is crafted to go with your life.

Sika's Sound Journeys are truly unique. They are sonic explorations that feature didgeridoos, drums, flutes, voice and orchestral elements. A collection of foraged sounds from objects he has recorded in nature, add even more textures. Many of his sounds are completely unrecognisable and abstract. Immersed in this cocoon of abstract sound, we can find ourselves in the most surprising places in our mind. In this timeless realm, beyond the normal limitations of rational reality, anything is possible.
An epic adventure deep inside yourself.
Journey to worlds within worlds on incredible sound waves.

Sika creates a safe space to relax deeply and connect with our inner guidance. This Sound Journey begins and ends with a short guided visualisation.
There will be two journeys with an interval. Most people choose to lie down, so bring a yoga mat, pillow and blanket and get really comfortable.
A journal is also recommended.
label: Religion & Spirituality

description:
SOLSTICE FULL MOON SONG AND SOUND CEREMONY, SOLSTICE FULL MOON SONG AND SOUND CEREMONY
Come and Sing, Sound and Meditate!

Want to mark the important time of the Solstice full moon?

Come and join with us on Sunday the 7th December for a group ceremonial gathering in Paraparaumu.

We will explore sacred conscious sounding practices to balance and align the energy system, sing healing chants and songs from different traditions, and explore guided vocal improvisation for freedom, upliftment and joy!

Ceremonial cacao will be served with focus and healing inTention.

There will be guided journal prompts around the energy of the Solstice and the whole session will finish with a full sound healing.

Everyone is welcome and there is no need for any particular preparation or pre existing skill.

Please get in touch with any questions or to book. Come and enjoy Song, Chant, Sound and Healing!!

So looking forward to gathering for the Solstice Full Moon on December 7th. Come and join with us to invoke and celebrate the energies of balance and creation at this profound time of year.

This session will explore singing, chanting, sounding and conscious voice empowerment practices. We will also explore energy practices like Qigong and meditation. All within a ceremonial framework.

Everyone is welcome. Limited spaces. Get in touch soon

You are warmly invited to book to join this powerful sound and voice ceremony which will work with Spirit, the forces of Nature and Bryony's skill and expertise in creating sound for growth and transformation.

This is a special opportunity to tune into the sacred energies and potentialities of this time of the Solstice: opening us to balance, healing, nourishment, new growth and positive change.

Bryony will invoke and work with the healing power of the supportive energies of Spirit, ancestors and our highest Selves. Bryony's has an extensive background experience with Spirit, the Earth forces and sacred lands; these forces are central to her practice and Self.

She will lead you firstly in a process of meditation, conscious sounding, toning and singing healing chants.

This use of our voices to co-create a sacred group sound is uplifting and transformative and will support you in your process of healing, releasing and visioning.

There will be time for guided journaling and intention setting.

The second section of the workshop will be a focused and dedicated sound bath which will bring balance and deep relaxation, into a sense of stillness and peace. There can be a sense of gratitude and appreciation.

Both the conscious use of the voice and the sound healing have many benefits, which are verified by science and which can effect us positively on the physical, mental, emotional, energetic and spiritual levels. A document which has more information about these benefits can be provided on request.

All are welcome:
I look forward to sharing with you and supporting you in this ceremony.

Investment for full 2.5 hours

description:
Self Healing Crystal Meditation Journeys, Self Healing Crystal Meditation Journeys
Are you ready to let “It” all go?
You are invited to take a journey deep into the energy of the Divine. Lying on the ground, with the heartbeat of Mother Earth beneath you, we take a meditation journey, deeper within our Soul energy. Slowly returning back to our true Soul self. Letting go of all connection to stress and the identity that the ego clings to.

Investing in the imagery that all of our cells hold the energy of our past. The trauma and struggles often block the gifts and wisdom from flowing through us. The wisdom and gifts are where the breath of the Divine can give life to our soul's purpose. When we surrender our hold on the trauma, struggles, pain and hardships of our past, we make room for the Divine to flow in.

In these journeys, we surrender all of the building blocks of our identity.

This then creates space for the new gifts to be connected into our soul magic. Allowing the energy of the creator to rebuild our Souls to hold the strongest vibration of our infinite possibilities.

We will be gridding ourselves in the crystals from the tent, before the journey. After the journey, you will have some quiet time to write, draw or just reflect.
These journeys are deep and divine. Please come in comfortable clothing and ready to be changed for the better.

🌸 Silent Retreat – A Day of Calm, Creativity & Inner Connection

Hosted by Lisa Conroy from Living the Sweet Life & Tracey Crandall from CharlieRae/TraceyLidene Art

📍 Lotus Yoga & Retreat Centre, 91 Ruapehu Street, Paraparaumu (a short stroll from the train station)
🗓️ Saturday, 24th January 2026
🕐10.00am - 3.00pm
💰 $125 — all materials provided
🥗 Light refreshments available throughout the day (BYO lunch)
✨ Event Link: https://facebook.com/events/s/silent-retreat-a-day-of-calm-c/1831388837742351/?

Shhh… can you hear it? That gentle whisper calling you back to yourself? 💫
Join us for a day designed to quiet the noise and awaken your inner calm through creativity, meditation, and mindful stillness.

You’ll be gently guided through soulful experiences — from sound bowls and meditation to creative journaling, intuitive art, and sacred self-care. This retreat is your space to exhale, reflect, and simply be. Surrounded by nature, a pond and birdsong.

✨ What’s Included:
🌿 Begin your day with a guided meditation and soothing sound healing
🌿 Infuse your crystal of intention — your quiet companion for the day (and it goes home with you)
🌿 Wander between creative stations at your own pace:

* Write a letter to yourself 💌
* Connect with nature through leaf rubbings & botanical sketches 🌸
* Create an intention or dream page from magazines 🌈
* Try teabag art, intuitive breath drawings, and mandala inserts 🎨
* Pull a symbol stone and reflect on what it means to you 🪶

Your beautiful journal (included) will grow with colour, words, and meaning as the day unfolds.

🌸 Pampering & Peace
Because we all need a little nurturing...
🩷 Foot soak stations (ahh, yes please!)
🩷 Self-pampering including warm stones to hold and melt away tension

Prompts to guide your day:
💫 Inspirational gentle prompts
💫 A space to leave little love notes of encouragement to be shared at the end

A gentle, soul-soothing day to rest, create, and reconnect — surrounded by stillness, soft energy, and kind hearts.
✨ Spaces are limited for this intimate experience.

Contact for further information or to book your place.

🪷Tracey Crandall -
🌸Lisa Conroy -


With Creativity, Sparkle & Soul,
Tracey & Lisa
CharlieRae & Living the Sweet Life

👯‍♀️ Meet your co-creators:
Tracey Crandall and Lisa Conroy are two creative souls who live for colour, connection, and sparking joy. Together, they blend art, play, and nurturing rituals into experiences that lift you up, light you up, and leave you glowing inside and out.

As winter draws to a close and the days get longer, Hutt City Chorale is pleased to present our second concert of the year. A concert for all the family. description:
Somatic Breathwork: Reignite The Fire, Somatic Breathwork: Reignite The Fire

This transformative Somatic Breathwork workshop is designed to help you reconnect with your body and emotions.

The practice focuses on breath-led nervous system regulation and emotional decompression. Using nose-dominant breathing with an optional mouth exhale, along with gentle somatic movements, you'll find a path to embodied clarity. Our unique Elebreath 5-Arc method allows you to explore your breath deeply, with the option to build up to cathartic releases.

This workshop is perfect for:
•⁠ ⁠Corporate burnout
•⁠ ⁠High achievers feeling the pressure
•⁠ ⁠Caring parents in need of respite
•⁠ ⁠Those experiencing stress and wired-and-tired fatigue
•⁠ ⁠Individuals dealing with overthinking and sleep disruptions
•⁠ ⁠People feeling heaviness in the chest
•⁠ ⁠Creative blocks that need unlocking
Welcome to beginners and all who seek a supportive environment!

What to expect
•⁠ ⁠Arrival ritual and consent check to create a safe space

•⁠ ⁠Breath demo to guide your practice
•⁠ ⁠Progressive breath arcs for deeper exploration
•⁠ ⁠Micro-shakes and unwinding to release tension
•⁠ ⁠Optional arm swings and body sways for movement
•⁠ ⁠Integration rest followed by journaling
•⁠ ⁠Live sound to enhance your experience

Benefits you may notice
•⁠ ⁠A deeper sense of calm
•⁠ ⁠Softer jaw and shoulders
•⁠ ⁠A steadier baseline for your emotions
•⁠ ⁠A clearer mind
•⁠ ⁠Improved sleep
•⁠ ⁠A lifted mood
•⁠ ⁠More emotional range without feeling overwhelmed
Structure and timing

Yoga mats & blankets are provided but you are welcome to bring:
•⁠ ⁠An extra yoga mat for comfort
•⁠ ⁠Warm layers and socks
•⁠ ⁠Water bottle
•⁠ ⁠Small towel
•⁠ ⁠Optional eye mask or light scarf
•⁠ ⁠Journal and pen

Pre-class prep
•⁠ ⁠Eat a light meal 2 hours before class.
•⁠ ⁠Hydrate well throughout the day.
•⁠ ⁠Avoid alcohol and recreational substances for 24 hours.
•⁠ ⁠Limit caffeine 4 hours prior.
•⁠ ⁠Arrive 10 minutes early for intake.
•⁠ ⁠If you have health conditions, check with your provider.
•⁠ ⁠Feel free to share anything with Lynn before the session at hi@lynofuro.co.nz.

Contraindications and safety
Breathwork can change your breath rate and surface emotions. It may not be suitable for:
•⁠ ⁠Pregnancy
•⁠ ⁠Serious cardiovascular issues
•⁠ ⁠Uncontrolled blood pressure
•⁠ ⁠Glaucoma or retinal detachment
•⁠ ⁠Epilepsy or seizure history
•⁠ ⁠Recent surgery or concussion
•⁠ ⁠Severe psychiatric conditions or active psychosis
•⁠ ⁠Heavy medications altering respiration
•⁠ ⁠Brittle osteoporosis

We offer a conservative track with nasal-only breathing, smaller ranges of motion, and breaks as needed. Please note that this is not medical care.

Aftercare
After the workshop, consider:
•⁠ ⁠Drinking water
•⁠ ⁠Eating nourishing food
•⁠ ⁠Engaging in simple movement or a short walk
•⁠ ⁠Journaling your insights
•⁠ ⁠Getting an early bedtime

Emotional waves may continue for 24 to 48 hours, and you're encouraged to reach out for support if needed.

Questions before you join? Email hi@lynofuro.co.nz, and Lynn will support you.

Meet Lynn, your facilitator
Lynn Tiang is an Integrative Somatic Coach specializing in Breathwork and Reiki, particularly for those experiencing corporate burnout, chronic pain, and stress. Her approach is gentle and accessible, providing nervous system-friendly support through the Elebreath 5-Arc method.

description:
Somatic Dance Wellington ~ Hara Rising, HARA RISING ~ FRIDAY EVENING SOMATIC DANCE

This month, we dance from the deep.
From the low-lit well within the pelvis, where instinct, intuition, and our inner fire reside.
Breath descends, awakening the Hara, our life force energy, clearing what no longer serves us.
Movement rises, carrying what wants to be felt, freed, and transformed, opening space for more joy and vitality.
We dance not to perform, but to reclaim our energy, our presence, our aliveness.
To sink into the molten center where your belonging, your power, and your knowing dwell.
Let your hips answer.
Let your breath carve.
Let the Hara lift you, guiding you toward the embodiment of your truest self and the year ahead.

For those wanting to meet the places that feel stuck, tight, or patterned, this space is for you. This isn’t about new-year resolutions, it’s about working with the energy you already hold with compassion.
A chance to let your body integrate, unwind, and move with more truth before the year ends, creating space to soften and transform through the rest of December, into the year ahead.


~ Friday 5th December
~ 7pm -9 pm
~Te Whaea National Dance and Drama Centre, Newtown
~Limited Spaces Available
~No Door Sales - Please purchase a ticket via Humanitix

------------------------------------------------------------------
The Wellington Somatic Dance Collective is thrilled to offer you our next morning dance space!
We are a passionate group of certified Somatic Dance facilitators and DJ's, eager to get you grooving on a Friday evening and set the perfect mood for your weekend.
Somatic Dance is a guided, free-form movement journey, delving deep into the layers of the body, supported by a carefully curated soundscape and live DJ.
Come and move to the rhythm of you, ready to deepen your connection with self and others. You'll leave feeling refreshed and high-vibed for the days ahead.
We can't wait to dance with you!
~ Julie, and Fiona of the Wellington Somatic Dance Collective x

description:
Sound Bath Experience: Ngā Wā o te Tau, Sound Bath Experience: Ngā Wā o te Tau

Experience Sound Bath Experience: Ngā Wā o te Tau, a journey through the seasons inspired by the natural rhythms of Aotearoa. “Ngā Wā o te Tau” means “The Seasons,” and this sound bath, guided by Smita and Peter with the rich tones of taonga pūoro and waiata, invites reflection on the cycles of nature and our connection to the world around us.

This immersion takes you from winter’s stillness, through spring’s blossoms, summer’s warmth, and autumn’s release, attuning to the changing energies of each season. Unique sounds encourage reflection, connection, and inner calm, while gentle karakia and mindful intention weave the journey together, creating a meditative space to pause and breathe.

After the sound bath, enjoy a nourishing plant-based dinner and dessert included in your ticket — a wholesome way to close the evening in good company.

Meet your hosts & musicians, Smita & Peter, Smita (Ngāi Te Rangi) was born and raised in Aotearoa. From a young age she was drawn to music as a means for reflection and self-expression. During her music studies at university, she was introduced to taonga pūoro, and this sparked a personal journey of reconnection to te ao Māori and her own whakapapa. Following university, she lived in an ashram for several years where she was introduced to the wonderful practice of bhakti yoga. She now lives with her husband in the Wellington region, where they regularly participate in kirtan (mantra music meditation) at Bhakti Lounge.

Peter is Pākehā, with grandparents from England and Ireland, and has been on a four-year journey learning the art of taonga pūoro — the traditional Māori musical instruments of Aotearoa. Guided by the wisdom and generosity of expert makers and players, he has learned both to craft and to play these unique instruments. For Peter, taonga pūoro offer a way to connect deeply with sound, story, and the natural world, and he is excited to share their voices as part of this sound bath experience.

What’s on the menu?
Jackfruit Rendang

Satay Seitan Skewer

Gado Gado salad with peanut sauce

Rice

Banana cake with caramel sauce

Hot "chocolate"

Their music has profoundly influenced her own sound healing practice, inspiring her to explore sound as a tool for transformation, connection, and inner peace.

description:
Sound Journey - PALMERSTON NORTH, Sound Journey - PALMERSTON NORTH
This powerful experience is like a soundtrack that is crafted to go with your life.
Something between an ancient ceremony and a movie soundtrack.
Please bring a yoga mat, pillow and blanket. Be prepared to drop into a deep space.
Door sales will be available if there is space. Advanced booking is recommended.
Sika's Sound Journeys are truly unique. They are sonic explorations that feature didgeridoos, drums, flutes, voice and orchestral elements. A collection of foraged sounds from objects he has recorded in nature, add even more textures. Many of his sounds are completely unrecognisable and abstract. Immersed in this cocoon of abstract sound, we can find ourselves in the most surprising places in our mind. In this timeless realm, beyond the normal limitations of rational reality, anything is possible.
An epic adventure deep inside yourself.
Journey to worlds within worlds on incredible sound waves.
Sika creates a safe space to relax deeply and connect with our inner guidance. This Sound Journey begins and ends with a short guided visualisation.
There will be two journeys with an interval. Most people choose to lie down, so once again, please bring a yoga mat, pillow and blanket to get really comfortable.
A journal is also recommended.

description:
Sound Therapy, Gong Bath with Hammocks, Join Nick for this therapeutic Gong Bath to unwind from the stress of your day/week/year, while being supported and held by your choice of a hammock. Hammocks and gongs aren't a common mix, but they work perfectly by allowing you to rest at ear level with the gongs, while having the extra comfort of not having a hard floor beneath you. If you prefer, there is space for floor seating along the edges of the studio.

If you haven't been to an event like this before, some of the benefits come from the sounds assisting the brain to reach deeper, more restful brainwave states, while the steady drones invite the nervous system to relax into the rest & digest mode. The sounds themselves are unlike anything else really, and sound like some kind of rich, harmonic, electronic music. Nick uses three medium-large Paiste gongs, full moon Tibetan singing bowls, monochord, zither, percussion, and a singing pyramid, and strucutres the set using his extensive training in Mindful Somatic Therapy and Music studies.

Nick has been producing and playing with music since his earliest teens, having graduated from The New Zealand School of Music, and later with a University qualification and work experience in experiential Psychology, combining those two worlds with events like these throughout Wellington and the lower North Island for the past 2.5 years.

If you live with any of these, please talk to your Doctor first, to make sure the event will be suitable:
-have a pacemaker or other implanted medical device
-live with epilepsy or a sound-sensitive condition
-are in the first trimester of pregnancy
-are experiencing severe or unmanaged mental health challenges (such as psychosis, schizophrenia, or PTSD)

Please bring along anything that'll help you feel more comfortable (pillow, eye mask, blanket, or earplugs if you live with tinnitus).

description:
Soundhealing & Yin Yoga, Soundhealing & Yin Yoga
Soundhealing & Yin Yoga
Step out of the rush and into a different pace. This session blends the long-held stillness of yin yoga with the raw, resonant tones of sound healing — creating space to drop tension, quiet the noise, and tune back into yourself.

Yin invites you to hold shapes for several minutes, not to push but to soften — giving your body time to open and your mind time to settle. Layered with live sound frequencies, the practice becomes a sensory journey that restores balance on a deeper level.

Emma brings a trauma-informed approach to yin, shaped by her own journey of self-growth and a belief in nourishing the body as a pathway to connection. Alongside Nizaad’s immersive soundscapes, the evening is less about performance and more about presence.

We’ll close the night by sharing a plant-based dinner and dessert — food to ground the experience in real connection.

All levels welcome.

Meet Emma, your yoga teacher
Emma holds a 100-hour trauma-informed Yin Yoga teacher certification, blending her corporate experience with a deep understanding of self-care. Emma's classes are designed to help create a safe space where you can relax and connect with your body. Her approach to teaching yin is purposeful, driven by a strong desire to empower students through mindful and compassionate practices. Her journey is rooted in self-growth and connection, with a strong focus on nourishing the body as an essential part of this.

Meet Nizaad, your sound healer
Nizaad holding a Reiki-infused Sound Journey designed to support deep rest and realignment. Blending the healing frequencies of crystal singing bowls alongside other sacred instruments, her sessions are rooted in the belief that sound and energy are medicine. Coming from a lineage of energy healers, she weaves gentle Reiki throughout the session to support subtle energetic balance and emotional release. Participants simply need to lie down and allow the sound and energy to wash over them, inviting a calm, restorative space to reconnect with the body and return to balance.

What’s on the menu?

Creamy farfalle pasta with plant-based bacon

Toasted bruschetta with cheese, tomato and parsley

Fresh salad with balsamic vinegar

Berry vanilla muffins with whipped cream

description:
Spiritual Healing, Spiritual Healing
Spiritual Healing is a healing modality where the practitioner acts as a clear channel for the healing energy to come through. Spiritual Healing is an effective method to bring about a deep, relaxing, enjoyable state which promotes self-healing. In some cases it will deal with the emotional release that is required at the time.
Spiritual Healing enables you to feel an inner peace. The loving touch of comfort and reassurance to regain the power within you, is always present.
The healing can be a moving and a heart felt experience.

description:
Summer Singing Retreat, Start the new year with intention in a fun and inclusive environment. The beginning of the year is a perfect time to get together and feel the power of community and connection through singing.

Sing for renewal and hope. Sing for harmony, joy, and inspiration. Sing for healing. Sing to regain your strength and empower others.

Spend the 2 days encircled by a community of like-minded people and focusing on your well-being through singing. Rest, connect, and restore. The weekend is carefully planned so there is plenty of time to sing and to rest in between.

We will breathe together, listen, create beautiful sounds, let go of our worries, and lift each other to a sense of fulfillment and joy. And to make the event even more special, Lala will be cooking an authentic Malagasy dinner on Saturday night (an experience not to be missed).

Jonathan Berkahn and Lala Simpson have been working together, leading workshops and performing for many years. They are both highly skilled song leaders who lead from the heart and joyfully share their gifts. You will be in safe hands. ALL SINGERS OF ALL LEVELS OF ABILITY ARE WELCOME!!!

Jonathan will teach a mix of pop, folk and original songs, and Lala will teach a mix of songs from South Africa, Georgia, Madagascar and community songs.

If you are coming from out of town, the Home of Compassion offers some accommodation with reasonable rates which includes breakfast. Please contact them directly to enquire islandbay@compassion.org.nz



SCHEDULE

Saturday, 17th of January: This first part of the retreat will be at the Island Bay Presbyterian Church. We will spend the day singing in the beautiful auditorium and share a Malagasy meal cooked by Lala at the end of the day. Morning tea, afternoon tea, and dinner provided. Please BYO lunch.

Sunday 18th of January: We will be singing in the Lyon Room at the Home of Compassion in Island Bay. We will finish the day singing the songs we learn through the weekend at a FREE community concert in the Chapel. Morning tea, afternoon tea, and lunch provided.

The Iskand Bay Presbyterian Church and the Home of Compassion are within walking distance of each other.

Bring a water bottle, swimming togs if you want to swim in Island Bay during lunch time, and a picnic mat for eating outside.

description:
Terra Soma Yoga & Sound Healing, Terra Soma Yoga & Sound Healing

This will be a gentle, invitational evening of yoga, sound, and embodied listening.

Terra soma yoga - translating to earth–body - brings together hatha yoga, somatic inquiry, and nature connection.

This special iteration of Terra Soma is accompanied by live sound healing, offering another layer of support for settling the nervous system and deepening awareness.

This practice invites you to sense into your inner landscape and notice how your body’s rhythms reflect the wider rhythms of the earth. Rather than striving or fixing, you’re encouraged to meet yourself as you are and enter an ongoing, living dialogue around well-being and what it means in the world we’re navigating today.

Throughout the practice, gentle soundscapes will weave through the space, created with a selection of instruments such as guitar, hang drum, and breath-based and melodic tones, responding intuitively to the energy of the room and the unfolding movement.

How is your heart? We often hear “follow your heart” or “listen to your heart,” but what does that actually mean? In this class, you’ll be invited into heart somatic enquiry - locating this intelligent organ, listening into this space, and perhaps allowing it to lead, inform, or express through movement.

The structure of this hour-long class includes:

A gentle lead-in towards the heart

A mixture of supine, seated, and standing asana

Repeated sequences with encouragement to make them your own — add or subtract asana, move in your own time, with your own breath

Optional free movement explorations

Live sound woven throughout to support relaxation, presence, and integration

This is an invitational practice. Everything is offered as a choice rather than an instruction. You’re encouraged to move in your own time, with your own breath, honouring what feels supportive in your body.

Your ticket includes a nourishing plant-based dinner and dessert, creating a spacious evening of movement, sound, heartful awareness, and wholesome connection.

Meet Abbie, your facilitator
Abbie is a 200-hour certified yoga teacher who trained with Awakening Arts: School of Yoga and Eco Somatics. She deeply values the insight, liberation, inner and collective resources somatic movement practices can offer. Abbie has also completed a 50-hour training exploring how yoga can support trauma awareness, mental health, and body image. She thrives in and intends to create spaces where each person’s pace is honored and the body’s innate wisdom is encouraged to emerge and lead.

Meet Andre, your sound healer

Andre is a multi-instrumental musician, poet, and pranayama (breathwork) facilitator who offers sound as a supportive layer for embodied awareness and relaxation. For this Terra Soma Yoga & Sound Healing experience, he will create live soundscapes using instruments such as guitar and hang drum, alongside gentle vocal and rhythmic elements, responding intuitively to the movement and energy in the room.

With a long-standing connection to circle work and embodied practices, Andre brings a grounded, attentive presence to the space. His work is guided by a curiosity about what it means to be fully human and how sound, breath, and presence can help us soften, listen inwardly, and reconnect with a sense of aliveness and ease.

description:
The Greatest Story - A Group of Wise Teachers Returning, Public Talk & Workshop

Throughout history, especially at times of crisis, great spiritual teachers have emerged to show humanity the next step forward.

According to British artist, author and esotericist Benjamin Creme, a group of such spiritual teachers is now living in the modern world. Maitreya, the World Teacher, and his group The Masters of Wisdom are here - not as religious teachers - to inspire all people to create a civilisation based on sharing, justice and peace; and for humanity to act to do the work to share and save our world.

Humanity at spiritual crossroads

Humanity is at crossroads. One path into the future leads to increasing social and economic division, environmental destruction, war and planetary peril. The other path leads to increasing social harmony, economic and environmental balance, and a golden era of peace.


Maitreya’s priorities

To help humanity in its task of global transformation, Maitreya has formulated certain priorities. They cover the essential needs of all people, every woman, man and child: an adequate supply of food; housing for all; healthcare and education as basic universal rights. Other top priorities include the restoration of the environment and the establishment of peace.

The key to achieving these goals requires a major shift of present mind-set and thinking, structures and systems – and more equitable sharing of the world’s food and resources. To realise humanity is one global family and the planet is a living being. According to Maitreya: “Without sharing, there can be no justice; without justice, there can be no peace; without peace, there can be no future.”

~ followed by short Transmission Meditation session ~

An immersive sound bath weaving timeless stories, live music and deep relaxation into a journey of reflection and calm.

Meet Smita, your host:
From a young age, Smita was drawn to music as a means for reflection and self-expression. During her music studies at university, she was introduced to taonga pūoro, and this sparked a personal journey of reconnection to te ao Māori and her own whakapapa. Following university, she lived in an ashram for several years where she was introduced to the wonderful practice of bhakti yoga. She now lives with her husband in the Wellington region, where they regularly participate in kirtan (mantra music meditation) at Bhakti Lounge.
Meet Alexandra, your host:
Alexandra is a sound healing practitioner devoted to nurturing healing in both mind and body. She believes that sound vibration holds the power to expand consciousness and restore harmony and balance in our lives. Her journey into sound healing began with the realization of how deeply sound vibration was affecting her psyche, making her more mindful of the music she listens to and the intention it carries. Along the way, she has drawn inspiration from artists such as Deva Premal, The Flying Mystics, Stevin McNamara, and the Bhakti Lounge Kirtan. Their music has profoundly influenced her own sound healing practice, inspiring her to explore sound as a tool for transformation, connection, and inner peace.

To book for a space in the bell tent- click here https://loveyourself.co.nz/events/p/bell-tent-meditations-
To book to do the journey over Zoom - Click here https://loveyourself.co.nz/events/p/journey-meditations-zoom

Every Tuesday night we welcome you into the magic of the bell tent. The tent is lovely during the day, but as it gets dark, it takes on a magical feeling. Fairy lights and crystals lit by gently changing coloured lights. We have the fire going if it's cold, the sky curtain pulled if it's a clear night.

The evening starts with us welcoming in the Elements, the Directions and the web of life, into our sacred circle. Arniya then dances the energy in with Celestial Energy Movement, for the group. This creates a vortex of Divine power into the middle of the tent. Each person is linked into this Divine power, and receives a "top-up" of Divinity.
We then have an opportunity for each person to hold the Talking Stick and send positive energy to their life, or current experience, or to ask the Divine for help. This is completely optional. Throughout the evening, you will have opportunities to choose oracle cards to support your guidance through life.

At 8pm the Zoom people join our circle. They will get to choose an oracle card and be connected into the vortex of power in the tent. This always creates an energy of expansion within the group.
Arniya then gives a wee run down of any current energies influencing the planet, before she leads everyone on a Journey Meditation. Some weeks we to the V.U soul plane. Sometimes we travel to our inner world. Sometimes the guardians take us somewhere else entirely. Each journey is channelled to support the needs of whoever is present.
After the meditation, we say goodbye to our Zoom friends, close the energy on the circle and give thanks. After this journey is complete, we have a cup of tea - time for a chat or playing with oracle cards, enjoying each other’s company in the uplifted space.

LIMITED PLACES REMAINING - BOOK NOW!!!

** Are you looking for a new, empowered sense of your voice? **

** Are you keen to dive deep into your energy and your connectio with yourself? **

You are warmly invited to join this unique FOUR DAY Heartsong Healing weekend HIGH-VIBTATIONAL retreat in a beautiful venue on the Kapiti Coast

Come, explore and celebrate the powerful energies of Vocal Rebirth together with other women, led by international Voice expert Bryony Rogers, originally from the UK now living in Kapiti.

This nurturing and deeply enjoyable retreat is a fabulous opportunity to dive deep into powerful Voice Empowerment, Singing, Conscious Sounding, Song work, Energy Healing and Visioning - all in peaceful, beautiful natural surroundings, and within a framework of mid-summer celebrations.

Also included are daily Yoga Sessions, Yin Yoga and Sound Healing, Qigong, Cacao Ceremony, Meditation, an Extra special Sauna experience and Nature Connection.

This retreat is open to any woman of any level of confidence and skill with her voice. The work will support those who are not confident with their voice and will also give new skills and tools to more confident singers and speakers.

Empower yourself through exploring deeply uplifting and energizing practices which enable you to connect with your authentic voice in an embodied way!

The powerful and transformative Voice practices will be held within the context of ritual, meditation and profound nature connection - including a healing cacao ceremony.

All these practices have a positive effect on the physical, emotional, mental and spiritual senses and are a great stress-relieving energizer!!

There will also be time and space to rest, journal, to be in nature in an unstructured way, to integrate the powerful energies of the Voice work, and to receive healing.

Look at the retreat website on https://www.songofawakening.com/vocal-rebirth-retreat

All of this wonder will be taught in a held safely facilitated space by Bryony from Heartsong Healing. Bryony has been working with the Voice and Energy in a dedicated conscious way for 27 years, after these practices helped her heal from chronic fatigue syndrome in the 1990s.

We're excited to invite you to an evening of insight and inspiration as we welcome Wes Huff for a special Thinking Matters event. description:
Wesley Huff | Leaders Lunch | Wellington, This September Wesley Huff is joining Thinking Matters for the Truth Matters Tour in Dunedin, Christchurch, Wellington and full-day Conference in Auckland.
While in Wellington, he will be doing his only Christian Leaders Lunch.
Proceedings
Doors will open 11:15 am
11:30 am - the event will begin with a short powhiri/mihi whakatau
11:50 am - Kai
12:20 pm - Wes will present his talk and do q and a
1:30 pm - Conclusion of event
About Wesley Huff
Wesley Huff was born in Multan, Pakistan, and spent a portion of his childhood in the Middle East. After being diagnosed with a rare neurological condition at the age of eleven that left him paralyzed from the waist down, Wes experienced a miraculous recovery for which the doctors themselves had no medical explanation. This experience, along with a great deal of study and soul searching in his later teen years, solidified his interest in faith and in engaging the beliefs and worldview perspectives of others. He spent his high school years in Northern Ontario and currently lives in Toronto, Canada, with his wife and three children.
Wesley is currently the Central Canada Director for Apologetics Canada and has been a guest on a variety of public platforms, from The Joe Rogan Experience and Piers Morgan Uncensored, to Apologia Radio and Daily Dose of Wisdom. He has participated in numerous public dialogues, debates, and interfaith events on issues of belief and religion globally.
He holds a BA in sociology from York University, a Masters of Theological Studies from Tyndale University, and is currently doing a PhD in New Testament at the University of Toronto’s Wycliffe College.

description:
Winter Solstice - Nourishing Cacao Ceremony & Golden Winter Sun Activation, Winter Solstice - Nourishing Cacao Ceremony & Golden Winter Sun Activation
You’re warmly invited to this Winter Solstice gathering on the afternoon of Sunday 21st June.


A space intentionally created for solace and comfort - with cosy blankets, cushions, candlelight, and warmth to gently hold you like a soft cocoon.

An opportunity to slow down, settle your nervous system, and feel supported and nourished through the depths of winter’s longest night.

This two-part experience begins with Alexandra guiding you through gentle movement and a ceremonial cacao journey to bring warmth as you unwind, ground into the present moment, and reconnect within.

From this centred space, Nicola will lead you through a reflective meditation and Golden Winter Sun Activation, welcoming the returning light.

This Winter Solstice gathering weaves together:

• Ceremonial-grade cacao to open the heart and support relaxation
• Gentle movement to soften and nurture the body
• Sacred drumming
• Intention setting ritual
• Guided meditation and activation journey
• Reflection, grounding, and deep rest

Arrive just as you are and leave feeling connected and replenished.


Even within the darkest night, there is wisdom to receive as the light slowly begins to return. ✨

IMPORTANT INFORMATION:
• Wear comfortable clothing — warm, cosy socks too!
• Bring a cushion or two and a blanket. The more comfy you are, the better. (The venue has some yoga mats, cushions, and blankets available to use.)
• Bring an eye mask or eye pillow if you have one — a few spares will also be available
• Please arrive 15 minutes early to settle in
• Bring an open heart and mind

When you arrive at the Hipsta shop, the friendly staff will welcome you and show you where to go.

Meet Rasesvari, your host

Rasesvari (pronounced Rah-say-shwari) has always remembered feeling connected to healing, the inner world, and what helps people feel well and in alignment. Growing up, she spent many hours tucked away in libraries, reading about philosophy, plants, and anything that felt meaningful or life-giving.
Her path took a few turns away from the usual route, leading her to spend six years in an ashram setting focused on self-development and spiritual life. During that time, she explored meditation deeply and had space to focus on her own healing. This naturally opened the door to learning about Traditional Chinese healing, Ayurveda, sound healing, bioresonance, and a lot of self-study along the way.
Her loving aim is simple: to create spaces where people can finally feel comfortable in themselves again and and have room for their own growth and healing.

Mystic Creative warmly invites you to join us for a very special evening to close out the last part of 2025. An intentional weaving of a multitude of instruments, beats and frequencies that will take you to places deep within yourself: an opportunity to explore, feel and release what no longer serves you.
